name: DSH-DREAM
description: Persistent long-term memory for LLM agents with a DSH-native settings panel.

enable_memory.title: Enable long-term memory
enable_memory.description: Turn Chroma-backed memory retrieval on or off. When off, memory_search returns an empty result without opening Chroma.

rag_path.title: Vector database path
rag_path.description: Leave blank to use the DSH user directory; enter an absolute path to customize, or set AGENT_MEMORY_RAG_PATH to override.

max_window_tokens.title: Window token budget
max_window_tokens.description: Token budget used to initialize WindowManager.

retrieval_top_k.title: Retrieval top-k
retrieval_top_k.description: Number of RAG memories returned by memory_search.

embedding_provider.title: Embedding provider
embedding_provider.description: local uses the bundled Chinese model; openai_compatible calls a cloud /embeddings API.

embedding_model.title: Embedding model
embedding_model.description: Cloud model name. Leave blank for the local BAAI model or the cloud default text-embedding-3-small.

embedding_api_key.title: Embedding API key
embedding_api_key.description: Bearer token for the cloud embedding endpoint. Stored in the local bridge config; shown masked in the panel.

embedding_base_url.title: Embedding base URL
embedding_base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL, for example https://api.deepseek.com/v1 (confirm it matches your API key).

auto_rebuild_collection.title: Re-embed old data on dimension mismatch
auto_rebuild_collection.description: Try to re-embed old records into the new vector dimension. Cloud embedding APIs may consume tokens.

holographic_mode.title: Holographic mode (force full memory)
holographic_mode.description: When enabled, every completed turn writes the complete User and Assistant originals to the vector store, regardless of whether the agent called a tool.
